text:
The abstract presents a broad synthesis showing that improving nanofluid composition (particle type, size, concentration, base fluid, dispersants) together with advanced MQL delivery (nozzle design, atomization, supply control) and a deeper grasp of tribological and thermal mechanisms leads to better machining outcomes across turning, milling, and grinding. This directly matches the general statement of Hypothesis 2, whereas the other hypotheses are overly specific or introduce elements not covered in the evidence.

CHOICE: 2
